Tomato___Early_blight: Pichhle patte hatayein. ICAR/KVK ki salah se anushanshit fungicide ka chhidkaav karein. Ek hi khet me lagatar tamatar na ugayein.
Tomato___Late_blight: Namee aur thande mausam me tezi se failta hai. Sankramit paudhe nikaalein, turant KVK se sampark karein.
Potato___Early_blight: Fasal chakra apnayein, sankramit patte hatayein, anushanshit fungicide ka prayog karein.
